clips.title: The story
paras: Newly risen Forsaken paladins leave Deathknell for instruction in Brill. Aramis Hammerhand sends them east into Tirisfal Glades, where dangers and distrust await those who wield the Holy Light.

After learning martial combat and channeling holy power in Deathknell's graveyard, you are sent east into Tirisfal Glades. Your destination is Brill, the regional outpost and administrative hub for central Tirisfal. There, Shari Stilwell oversees the training of those who follow the path of the paladin in undeath.

Aramis offers parting advice about the peril of being an undead paladin. Lordaeron still needs defenders against threats from beyond, yet wielding the Holy Light under Sylvanas Windrunner's banner draws suspicion. Many Forsaken suffered agony or death at the hands of holy zealots, and the Light's presence breeds distrust among their undead kin.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Lordaeron may not be what it used to be, but our home still needs protection from all manner of threats and it's time for you to go out and face the world. Your next stop should be the town of Brill in central Tirisfal Glades. Go and meet with Shari Stilwell there. She can see to your continued training.
One last bit of advice before you go--take extra care as a paladin traveling through Forsaken lands. There are many in the Dark Lady's service who distrust us and our proximity to the light.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Welcome aboard, paladin. It's always encouraging to see more of our number roaming these lands. There are many here in Brill in need of assistance from adventurers such as yourself. Seek employment and grow stronger in the light. Return to me whenever you need training.
When you've proven yourself to myself and the people of Brill, I will provide guidance for the next leg of your journey.
